title: CrowdSec Hub rule set (v0.5, D39)
description: A set of the CrowdSec Hub source as the gateway keeps it: the image snapshot (make crowdsec-snapshot) and the stored last good set (schild.db key crowdsec_hub_set_v1) have this one format. It holds the selected hub items as they came, not the converted SecLang: every load converts them again, so a new contract version applies to old sets, and skipped rules stay listed with their current reason. Licence: MIT, the NOTICE ships with it (crowdsec-hub.md section 7).

index_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the downloaded .index.json: the identity of the set.

hub_commit.description: The git commit, when known: a pin, or the image snapshot. The index of the master branch names none.

hub_commit_at.description: Commit time of hub_commit, when known. make crowdsec-snapshot always sets it. Set.Time compares sets with it: this, else fetched_at for a set of the master branch, else no date.

not_selected.description: Items of the index outside the virtual patching collection.

rules.description: Every selected item, loaded or skipped, sorted by name.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the decoded content, as in the index.

content.description: The YAML of the rule in base64, as in the index.

changed_at.description: Last change of the digest; the settling period counts from here.
